nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point: POST /recipes/generate with ingredients and preferences from the Angular app.

nodes.name: Validate input
nodes.notes: Checks ingredients (1-20, name, amount, unit) and preferences again, independent of the frontend. Too little food for the portions -> 422 INSUFFICIENT_INGREDIENTS.

nodes.name: Input valid?
nodes.notes: Valid input goes on to the prompt, invalid input is answered right away.

nodes.name: Respond invalid input
nodes.notes: Answers with 400 INVALID_INPUT or 422 INSUFFICIENT_INGREDIENTS.

nodes.name: Build prompt
nodes.notes: Builds the Gemini request: prompt with all recipe rules (70 % of the ingredients, max. 3 extras, beginner friendly) and a JSON response schema.

nodes.name: Gemini
nodes.notes: Calls the main Gemini model. Retries once, errors go to the fallback model.

nodes.name: Gemini fallback
nodes.notes: Same request with the lighter fallback model if the main model fails.

nodes.name: Check recipes
nodes.notes: Parses the Gemini answer. Wrong format -> generator error. Rule violation (ingredient share, extras) -> RECIPE_RULES_NOT_MET.

nodes.name: Save to Firebase
nodes.notes: Saves every recipe in the Realtime Database (/recipes) and gets its id back.

nodes.name: Build response
nodes.notes: Combines the saved ids with the recipes and adds the remaining generations of today.

nodes.name: Respond recipes
nodes.notes: Answers with 200 and the 3 generated recipes.

nodes.name: Respond generator error
nodes.notes: Answers with 502 if Gemini or Firebase fail.

nodes.name: Rules met?
nodes.notes: Valid recipes are saved, rule violations are answered with 422 so the app can retry.

nodes.name: Respond rules not met
nodes.notes: Answers with 422 RECIPE_RULES_NOT_MET; the app retries once automatically.

nodes.name: Fail execution
nodes.notes: Marks the execution as failed after the 502 answer so the error handler workflow logs it and sends a mail.

nodes.name: Identify client
nodes.notes: Reads the client IP from the proxy headers and validates it (IPv4 and IPv6). Also sets the quota day (Europe/Berlin).

nodes.name: Hash IP
nodes.notes: Hashes IP + day with SHA-256, so no plain IP is stored.

nodes.name: Read quota
nodes.notes: Reads the counters of today from /quota/{day} in the Realtime Database.

nodes.name: Check quota
nodes.notes: Allows the request if the IP has less than 3 and the system less than 12 successful generations today.

nodes.name: Request allowed?
nodes.notes: Allowed requests go on to Gemini, others are answered right away.

nodes.name: Respond request denied
nodes.notes: Answers with 429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED or 400 INVALID_CLIENT.

nodes.name: Count generation
nodes.notes: Counts the successful generation for the IP and the whole system (atomic increment).

nodes.name: Quota webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point: GET /recipes/quota, returns the remaining generations of today for the client.

nodes.name: Identify quota client
nodes.notes: Same IP detection as "Identify client".

nodes.name: Hash quota IP
nodes.notes: Same hash as "Hash IP".

nodes.name: Read quota status
nodes.notes: Reads the counters of today.

nodes.name: Build quota status
nodes.notes: Calculates the remaining generations for the IP, limited by the daily system limit.

nodes.name: Respond quota
nodes.notes: Answers with { remaining, limit }.
